status: generated evidence-grounded snapshot; no facet at 10
claim_scope: Actionable realization and verification audit of the live MOP repository. Scores do not license broad cognitive, autonomous-status, moral-status, natural-video, embodiment, or physical-material claims.

definitions.demonstrated-capability: A preregistered treatment survived its strongest controls on appropriate independent units and an independent verifier promoted the bounded claim.
definitions.executed-mechanics-readiness: The end-to-end path, identities, controls, and failure behavior execute, but capability promotion is blocked by evidence class, power, control completeness, or verifier outcome.
definitions.demonstrated-null-or-closure: A valid experiment rejected the lever or excluded its registered margin. This raises falsification maturity, not the refuted capability.
definitions.planned-scaffold-only: A research question, registry row, schema, or preflight exists without an executed end-to-end mechanism.
definitions.irreducible-gate: A participant, rights authority, live sensor/environment, physical specimen, or human governance dependency that software and additional compute cannot substitute for.

scaffolding.ten: All currently actionable contracts, identities, nulls, controls, metrics, dependencies, refusal rules, and tests are complete.

implementation.ten: Every currently local mechanism runs end to end, resumes safely, and fails closed.

experiment.ten: Every currently actionable experiment has run on appropriate independent units with the strongest declared controls. A null counts as completion, not capability.

confirmation.ten: Independent recomputation, corrected uncertainty, adequate independent units, transfer, and external validity appropriate to the claim are closed.

scoring.rounding: round the capped score to one decimal
scoring.ten_definition: All currently actionable potential is implemented, executed, and verified. Explicit irreducible gates may remain, but no local precursor, control, verifier, or handoff task may remain.

ladder.6: multi-seed local mechanics or citable intake
ladder.7: strong controls and durable project-controlled result
ladder.8: causal, transfer, or natural-data evidence with independent verification
ladder.9: replication across tasks, substrates, or environments
ladder.10: all current actionable potential realized and verified

anti_score_inflation: Tests prove code behavior, not scientific truth.
Programmatic fixtures cannot confirm natural, embodied, social, developmental, or material claims.
Natural input integrity alone does not prove representation value.
Ceilinged, tiny-n, or underpowered results cannot establish specialness.
Missing matched-random, strongest-shell, compute, data-order, or referent controls block promotion.
Seeds are not independent data when referents, sessions, participants, or specimens are reused.
Nulls raise falsification maturity but do not raise the capability they refute.
Inherited-model execution proves availability and cost, not learned-code value or project ownership.
Rights, environments, participants, and specimens are never compute blockers.
Stale embedded hashes lose confirmation credit until refreshed.
A SHA-256 hash proves integrity, not signer identity or independent authority.
Functional workspace, self-model, report, or integration evidence never licenses nonfunctional or moral-status claims.
No score includes an unimplemented future architecture or hypothetical Studio result.
Documentation alone can raise scaffolding only; the experiment and confirmation caps remain binding.
